content.title: Strategic Alignment
content.summary: The City Council Strategic Plan outlines five key areas of focus: Homelessness, Housing, Local Economy, Physical and Technology Systems, and Quality of Life. Each area includes specific goals and actions aimed at enhancing community services, improving housing access, supporting local businesses, upgrading infrastructure, and ensuring a high quality of life for residents. The plan emphasizes transparency and community engagement in its implementation.
content.body:
The City Council Strategic Plan (CCSP) includes five Strategic Results: Homelessness, Housing, Local Economy, Physical and Technology Systems, and Quality of Life. Each Strategic Result can be accessed below and includes corresponding goals along with internal actions and measures being monitored and reported on by the City Team. This webpage communicates how the City Team is implementing the City Council's vision, fostering trust and transparency in our efforts to keep the community informed and engaged.

[View the City Council Strategic Plan](/DocumentCenter/View/4218/COA-Council-Strat-Plan-2024-ADA---facing-pages-1).

---

![](/ImageRepository/Document?documentId=4196)

## [Homelessness](/1052)

Collaborate and coordinate with nonprofits, local organizations, and regional governments to advance services to individuals experiencing homelessness or at risk of experiencing homelessness

![](/ImageRepository/Document?documentId=4198)

## [Housing](/1053)

Improve access to diverse, safe, and affordable housing options and programs, providing residents with opportunities to obtain housing that meets their needs in all phases of life.

![](/ImageRepository/Document?documentId=4199)

## [Local Economy](/1054)

Bolster a vibrant local economy by delivering efficient and cost-effective services as well as providing support for business in Arvada.

![](/ImageRepository/Document?documentId=4200)

## [Physical and Technology Systems](/1055)

Improve City and community connectivity by providing reliable and accessible physical and technology systems.

![](/ImageRepository/Document?documentId=4201)

## [Quality of Life](/1056)

Foster an accessible and inclusive community that preserves and improves quality of life and ensures a safe and thriving place for all community members.
